definitions.core_principle: The 12th is not a blanket 'hiding' house. The same planet in the 12th gives opposite results in different charts. Decide positive vs negative from: (1) the 12th lord's strength, (2) benefic aspects/connections, (3) retrogression, (4) whether that planet's dasa runs in a usable life window.
definitions.strong_12th_lord: own sign / exalted, OR in kendra/trikona, OR connected (conjunction, aspect, star, exchange) with lord_1, lord_5 or lord_9
definitions.positive_support: lord_12 strong OR Jupiter / lagna lord / lord_5 / lord_9 aspects or connects the planet
definitions.negative_trigger: lord_12 weak, OR the planet itself retrograde (except where a rule says retrograde helps)
definitions.dasa_gate: All results below act only in the dasa/bhukti of the planet concerned.
definitions.twelfth_from_reference: The '12th' logic also applies to 12th from the dasa lord and 12th from the Moon sign, and can be used in transits.
definitions.derived_houses: Read relatives via bhavat-bhavam (e.g. 5th = 2nd from 4th = mother's family; 7th = 4th from 4th = mother's health). A malefic in a house does not condemn every signification of that house - check the relevant lord and karaka.

branches.then: Each planet's dasa becomes yogic
Their dasas give 12th-house losses

rules.name: Sun in 12th

branches.then: Ancestral property received, carries on father's line of work, father's support, status protected, government help
Financial strain, damage to professional standing, loss of ancestral property

rules.note: For Kataka and Simha lagna the Sun in 12th is not counted as hidden.

branches.if: dispositor strong OR Jupiter / lord_1 / lord_5 / lord_9 aspects
branches.then: Moon dasa spreads name and fame (even abroad); strong imagination

branches.if: dispositor weak OR Rahu/Ketu aspect without support
branches.then: Mental stress; indecision

connections.result: Fond of food; tendency to gain weight

rules.name: Debilitated Moon in 12th (Dhanus lagna)
rules.condition: Moon (8th lord) debilitated in Vrischika, 12th from Dhanus
rules.result: Viparita raja yoga; with Jupiter aspect/conjunction -> neecha-bhanga; Moon dasa becomes yogic.

rules.name: Mars in 12th

branches.then: Earns and buys property personally; relocates/sells and rebuys, renovates
Friction with siblings, land disputes, distress sale of property to clear debts

rules.remedy_note: Traditional remedy: Murugan worship (display only, not a computed result).

branches.then: Chandra-Mangala yoga: wealth, property, mass following and public influence
Leaves native place, self-earns large property elsewhere, often in a woman's name (wife/mother/sister) or jointly; may become commercial; access/water/power to the site takes effort

rules.name: Mercury in 12th
rules.note: 12th is NOT a hiding place for Mercury (6th and 8th are).

branches.then: Good education, eloquent speech, business skill; support from maternal uncle / father-in-law / brother-in-law
Skin, stomach, shoulder/back/leg pain, respiratory trouble; friction with in-laws or maternal uncle; land documentation/patta problems

rules.name: Sun + Mercury in 12th (Budhaditya in moksha house)
rules.result: Exceptional learning and skill in arts; fast progress in education; fine speaker.

branches.then: In Jupiter dasa: anxieties, future, children, health, deep spirituality, prophetic dreams, meditation, charity, pilgrimages, rediscovers kula deivam, soft-hearted, honest, generous to a fault, always repays debts
Bold, fearless; 'work is worship' - little interest in rituals/temples

rules.name: Venus in 12th

branches.then: Wealth/business via women (mother, mother-in-law, sister, sister-in-law); earnings grow with relocation or when spouse also works / joint business; imagination (with Mercury: writing); enjoys food, likes sweet and sour
Still not 'no vehicle': with strong lord_4 buys vehicles on loan and may earn through them (rental/attached to offices)

rules.note: Marriage outcome with Venus in 12th varies widely - never predict 'no marriage' from placement alone.

branches.then: Generally yogic (malefic in 12th); possible friction with paternal uncle or elder brother; night birth -> friction/separation from father in Saturn dasa
Job-hopping, relocation for work, expects status beyond ability
Major yoga - financial/career rise, own business; even greater if connected to Rahu/Ketu
Exception: harms family, finances or health
Own business succeeds; large earnings and investment gains

rules.name: Rahu in 12th
rules.condition: Rahu dasa; deciding authorities = sign lord and star lord of Rahu

branches.if: sign lord and star lord connected (kendra/trikona, mutual aspect, conjunction) and NOT 6/8 or 2/12
branches.then: Great yoga in Rahu dasa
Family trouble, legal issues, selling assets to clear debts

branches.if: both afflicted AND Venus and 7th/2nd weak
branches.then: Separation possibly to divorce; sometimes reunion after the period

rules.name: Ketu in 12th
rules.result: Same spiritual results as Jupiter in 12th, pilgrimage, meditation, liberation, keeps sorrows to self, very loyal and trustworthy, earns name through charity.

rules.name: 12th lord with Ketu
rules.result: Strong altruism and helping nature, tender, timid mind

rules.name: Retrograde links retrograde
rules.condition: retrograde planet in lagna in its own star, dispositor also retrograde
rules.result: Both dasas good; bigger yoga if Rahu/Ketu connect by aspect, conjunction or star.

rules.name: Planet at 29 degrees
rules.result: Judge it in the sign it occupies; do not shift to the next sign.

rules.name: Transit Jupiter over natal Venus
rules.result: Marriage if unmarried, vehicles, house, property, financial rise, reconciliation with female relatives.

rules.name: Transit Jupiter over natal Jupiter
rules.result: Finances, peace of mind, health, travel improve; joy through children (elders); new and profitable investments; stuck money recovered; enemies reconcile.

rules.name: Benign 12th combinations (Q&A)
examples: Saturn + Rahu in 12th: career rise; better if Venus is strong
Mercury + Mars + Sun in 12th (Kanni from Simha): fine
Sun + Moon in 12th with Moon own sign (Simha lagna): yogic
Moon, Venus, Sun in 12th: positive overall - Moon-Venus especially good

excluded_from_engine: Omen / nimitta-based reading (torn notebook page, body language) - not computable
Physical-habit trivia (bedsheets, eating style) - display at most as flavour text
open_questions_for_implementation: Day/night birth flag needed for P12-11 (sunrise/sunset from birth data)
Overlap with twelfth_lord_placement and ketu_12th - de-duplicate in shared definitions
